curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Vincent Malloy only wants to inhabit the eerie world of his idol, but his mother's patience is wearing thin.
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Tim Burton, this animated fantasy follows young Vincent Malloy, who yearns to be like Vincent Price and drifts into macabre, introspective daydreams that steadily annoy his mother.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Short, slow-paced, and gently macabre, offering an easy and atmospheric watch suited for a quiet moment alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: At just six minutes, it delivers a distinct, gothic-tinged look into a child's peculiar inner world, blending fantasy with a light, thoughtful touch.
